versions.changelog:
- Initial release: multi-platform account homepage video extractor with batch download
- Supports Douyin, Kuaishou, Bilibili, and YouTube; requires only platform name and account identifier/link
- Automatically fetches recent works, parses download links (no watermark), supports one-click batch local download
- Includes features like works pagination, date range filtering, Markdown/JSON output, and works statistics
- Comprehensive CLI usage guide and integration recommendations for agents
- Strict output formatting and user guidance to ensure accuracy and completeness
